subject: PICTURE clause
notes: LANDED 2026-09-09 (kb/Work PB528). 'Neither the symbol S nor the symbol * shall be specified in character-string-1 when the BLANK WHEN ZERO clause is specified for the subject of the entry' - both legs are COBOL1934 (golden entries PB09 for * and PB10 for S). The S leg was worse than an unenforced rule: the numeric-edited promotion in Analyze required !signed, so PIC S9(5) BLANK WHEN ZERO SILENTLY DISCARDED the clause and the item stayed pure numeric, leaving '0000{' where the programmer asked for spaces. The validator now runs before that promotion, so the entry is refused rather than quietly re-interpreted. retired-witness: unit:PictureCompositionTests.BlankWhenZeroWithSOrAsterisk_IsCOBOLNET1934 (the same witness, re-spelled when the diagnostic code prefix became COBOL#### (kb/Work PB3575); the new spelling is recorded in its place)
